name: may-agent
description: Persistent feature-unit sub-agent system built on pi-agent-core

scripts.bundle: mkdir -p bundle && bun build --compile src/app/binary-entry.ts --outfile bundle/may-agent
scripts.reload: bun run bundle && docker cp bundle/may-agent may-agent:/usr/local/bin/may-agent && docker exec may-agent chmod +x /usr/local/bin/may-agent && docker exec may-agent supervisorctl restart may-agent may-agent-web
scripts.reload:web: bun run bundle && docker cp bundle/may-agent may-agent:/usr/local/bin/may-agent && docker exec may-agent chmod +x /usr/local/bin/may-agent && docker exec may-agent supervisorctl restart may-agent-web
scripts.recreate: bun run build && bun run up
scripts.restart: docker exec may-agent supervisorctl restart may-agent may-agent-web
